name: openCashDesk
intent: Open the selected cash desk and make it the current cash desk.
pre: A cash desk with the supplied cashDeskID exists.
The selected cash desk is closed.
post: Make the selected cash desk the current cash desk.
Mark the selected cash desk as open.
difficulty_basis: Guarded desk transition and current-desk binding; no branch.
scenarios: Closed desk becomes open and current; true result asserted.
Missing desk/current store violate explicit guards.
effects_audit: No desk-store membership constraint, authentication guard or sale creation inferred.
